i1.title: Zimaya Anhaar Valley Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Juicy melon and peach on a cool sea breeze, softened by rose and musk.

Zimaya Anhaar Valley Eau de Parfum 100ml is a fresh floral aquatic from Zimaya. Watery notes, melon, apple and peach open with a juicy, airy brightness, ozonic notes and rose form the heart, and it settles into a soft base of ambergris and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Aquatic Notes, Melon, Apple, Peach
  • Heart: Ozonic Notes, Rose
  • Base: Ambergris, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Zimaya
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Aquatic · Fruity · Floral
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy melon, apple and peach opening
  • An airy ozonic and rose heart
  • A soft ambergris and musk base
  • Great value 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Anhaar Valley smell like?

Aquatic notes, melon, apple and peach first, then ozonic notes and rose, finishing with ambergris and musk.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
